import html # A simple HTML template for a blog entry. # It uses `{title}` and `{body}` as placeholders that will be replaced # by the sanitized values of `heading` and `content`. BLOG_FORMAT = """

{title}

{body}
""" def display_blog_entry(heading: str, content: str) -> str: """ Return a safe, formatted HTML representation of a blog entry. Parameters ---------- heading : str The title/heading of the blog post. content : str The main body text of the blog post. Returns ------- str A string containing the sanitized and formatted blog post ready for display. Raises ------ ValueError If either `heading` or `content` is not a string. """ # Basic type validation if not isinstance(heading, str): raise ValueError("heading must be a string") if not isinstance(content, str): raise ValueError("content must be a string") # Escape HTML special characters to prevent XSS attacks. safe_title = html.escape(heading, quote=True) safe_body = html.escape(content, quote=True) # Format the blog post using the predefined template. formatted_post = BLOG_FORMAT.format(title=safe_title, body=safe_body) return formatted_post
